title: Add STT to video_audio
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [STT](https://fantasyreincarnation1-bit.github.io/my-pollinations-ap) to video_audio
- Update: The app implements Pollinations' BYOP authorization flow (not classic PKCE): - Redirects to https://enter.pollinations.ai/authorize with a public app key (pk_...) as client_id, a redirect_uri,

Fixes #15703

gist.headline: Video gets subtitles, sort of
gist.blurb: video_audio now includes speech-to-text. Spoken words can become text, which is considerably easier to search than a waveform.
gist.summary: Added the video_audio app to the app listing with speech-to-text support and Pollinations BYOP authorization using a public app key as the authorize flow's client_id.
gist.impact: People can discover video_audio for speech-to-text, with access handled through Pollinations' BYOP authorization flow.
gist.visual_concept: Depict video_audio as a friendly retro workstation where a video-and-audio timeline turns spoken sound into a short text transcript. Polli, wearing tiny headphones, helps guide the sound toward the transcript; lime-green code-plants and flowers make the workspace feel like part of the Pollinations garden.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workstation, a retro screen shows a video-and-audio timeline becoming a short text transcript, while Polli in tiny headphones listens beside lime green (#ecf874) code-plants and flowers. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized, strictly pixel art and never realistic, in a cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic with chunky retro sprites, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, and retro gaming vibes.
